meta.readMethod: the sheet's HTML view read cell by cell in the owner's browser (scripts/export-sheet-tabs.js); SHA-256 of each tab's rows as canonical JSON

unit.row: one row of 02_FACILITIES — a source identity the owner approved into the dataset: a CityMETER production Hospital record or an HCODE register record; not a field-verified census of unique operating facilities
unit.beds: official_reported_beds_text — the beds in use HCODE reports; 0 is a reported 0, blank is unknown; not staffed beds or occupancy
unit.price: DIT published prices of six lab items (CBC 30101, UA 31001, lipid 32004, BUN 32201, creatinine 32202, glucose 32203) and their sum; effective date not shown by the source; not a bill, a package or the facility’s price level
unit.quality: HA stage and recorded dates (HA snapshot 31 Aug 2026 + public directory 31 Oct 2026) and JCI programmes (directory 31 Oct 2026) as published; accreditation evidence, not an outcome ranking

adminMethods.name: the row's own district (HCODE, else production) is a production district of its province
adminMethods.code: the row's HCODE district code is a production district of its province
adminMethods.point: the row's production point lies in a production district of its province
adminMethods.conflict: the row's production point lies in another province: placed nowhere

meta.districts: CityMETER production base info (lv0/lv1, receipts in data/boundary-receipts.json) + district outlines of data/frames/{CODE}.json

points.source: CityMETER production Hospital (citymeter-v3/hospital/overlayMvt, layer-hospital-detail, one request per district)
points.rule: production point of the facility, joined by citymeter_main_code; HCODE rows carry no point

rail.rule: operating = on the operator roster of CityMETER · Transit; construction = a project station, not a service; straight-line distance from the facility point to the station reference point, up to 2000 m

role.source: CityMETER production Hospital (NHSO service network, open data mastercupuc FY2568 Q3)
role.rule: role_group of the production point: CUP first, else primary, else referral, else ungrouped
